name: GPU Hardware Deep Dive: Architecture, Memory and Interconnects
description: An engineer's tour of the modern data center GPU: how SMs and CUs, warps and wavefronts, tensor and matrix cores and the on-chip memory hierarchy work; what FP64 through FP4 and sparsity really buy you; how HBM, PCIe, NVLink, Infinity Fabric, UALink and CXL move data; and how power, cooling and reliability features shape real deployments. Reviewed against vendor sources as of October 2026.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: GPU Hardware Deep Dive: Architecture, Memory and Interconnects

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 21 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 45 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
